extraction.name: VAP-Data
extraction.description: VAP-Data is a semantic-controlled paired dataset for video generation introduced to support the Video-As-Prompt framework. It contains over 100K curated paired videos across 100 semantic conditions spanning concept, style, motion, and camera categories.
extraction.creator: Yuxuan Bian; Xin Chen; Zenan Li; Tiancheng Zhi; Shen Sang; Linjie Luo; Qiang Xu
extraction.citeAs: Yuxuan Bian, Xin Chen, Zenan Li, Tiancheng Zhi, Shen Sang, Linjie Luo, and Qiang Xu. Video-As-Prompt: Unified Semantic Control for Video Generation. arXiv:2510.20888, 2025.
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The dataset was bootstrapped by curating high-quality reference images from the Internet and then using Image-to-Video visual-effects templates from commercial models (VIDU and Kling) and community LoRAs to create paired videos by matching each image to compatible templates.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionType: Manual Human Curator; Secondary Data analysis
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: 2K high-quality reference images from the Internet, plus Image-to-Video visual-effects templates from commercial models (VIDU and Kling) and community LoRAs.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: the semantic conditions in VAP-Data are relatively limited, synthetic, and derived from other generative models, which may inherit the specific stylistic biases, artifacts, and conceptual limitations of the source templates
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: the semantic conditions in VAP-Data are relatively limited, synthetic, and derived from other generative models; inaccurate semantics descriptions or large subject mismatch can degrade generation quality; with multiple references, the model may blend unwanted visual details across videos; the added parameters introduce extra inference cost—higher memory use and longer runtime
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: VAP targets semantic-controlled video generation for research, education, and creative prototyping; potential misuses include identity impersonation, “deepfake” content, targeted harassment, deceptive political messaging, and generation of sexualized or violent media
extraction.rai:personalSensitiveInformation: Potential misuses include identity impersonation, “deepfake” content, targeted harassment, deceptive political messaging, and generation of sexualized or violent media.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: semantic-controlled video generation for research, education, and creative prototyping; visual effects; video stylization; motion imitation; camera control
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: We will accompany any artifact release with a research-only license and an acceptable-use policy (AUP) that explicitly prohibits abusive or unlawful scenarios.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: They curated thousands of high-quality real images and then used Image-to-Video visual-effects templates from commercial models (VIDU and Kling) and community LoRAs to create paired videos by matching each image to all compatible templates, obtaining a synthetic paired dataset with over 100K samples.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: They resize videos to 480 × 720 (832) and sample 49 frames at 16 fps.
